title: Codex transcript tests: isolate CODEX_HOME and mocked homedir per test
answers: how to test Codex transcript discovery with CODEX_HOME
test pollution from CODEX_HOME in Codex integration tests
mock home directory in Codex transcript tests
where to add Codex transcript lookup tests
body:
Local test convention in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/tests/transcript.test.ts (describe 'findTranscriptForThread').
Tests that set CODEX_HOME save the original value in beforeEach and restore it in afterEach, deleting the variable when it was undefined; otherwise the value leaks into later tests.
Home directory is controlled by jest.mock('node:os') with jest.requireActual spread and homedir as jest.fn(); the mock specifier must match the 'node:os' import used by src, and afterEach resets it with jest.mocked(homedir).mockReset().
Fixtures are built in an mkdtemp directory under tmpdir() (sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-...-<threadId>.jsonl), with fake timers set to a fixed date, and removed with rmSync in afterEach.
Cover the precedence cases together: CODEX_HOME set, unset, and empty.
applies: Tests for Codex integration code that read environment variables or the user home directory.
says: Verify transcript discovery behaves correctly across custom, omitted, and blank directory locations.
Test that assistant session records are found when pointing to custom storage folders.
Ensure automated tests for assistant transcript lookup do not leak environment settings.
Validate that session transcript search functions properly when the user folder is relocated.
